competency_comparison.SU-NS-20: Recognize intracranial aneurysm as the cause of subarachnoid hemorrhage and identify basic definitive treatment options.
competency_comparison.SU-OP-41: Interpret RAPD, pupil-involving versus pupil-sparing third-nerve palsy, and pharmacologic versus neurologic mydriasis or miosis.

groups.original_deferral_reason: MULTI_COMPETENCY_OWNER_CONFLICT: this unit bundles optic/retinal RAPD interpretation, compressive third-nerve-palsy emergency recognition, and pharmacologic pupil abnormalities; one owner would not safely represent the established multi-competency unit.
groups.rationale: The targeted Neurosurgery counterpart covers only the aneurysm component. RAPD interpretation and pharmacologic pupil abnormalities remain separable competencies with different natural owners, so the established unit cannot safely receive one owner without a later complex-ownership design.

competency_comparison.SU-ID-02: Diagnose community-acquired and nosocomial pneumonia, assess severity, and initiate empiric management from substantive general pneumonia teaching.
competency_comparison.SU-P-109: Select empiric pediatric pneumonia therapy by age-specific likely pathogens.
competency_comparison.SU-P-149: Select age-stratified pediatric pneumonia therapy and interpret respiratory rate relative to age.
competency_comparison.SU-R-07: Recognize pneumonia, assess severity, choose initial investigations and management, and identify need for admission or referral from a cross-reference-only source.

groups.original_deferral_reason: The zero-allocation Respirology redirect does not identify one safe external owner: its stated pneumonia context spans Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Pediatrics, and Family Medicine, with unresolved pediatric internal overlap.
groups.rationale: Targeted inspection identifies SU-ID-02 as the substantive general pneumonia counterpart with the same diagnosis, severity, and initial-management competency. The pediatric units remain meaningfully age-specific and are not altered by this decision.
